A subplan tree as an interactive table

Source: R/table.R
tbl_tree.Rd

Every plan in the tree as a row, indented by depth: what it backs, its grain and cadence, how big it is, and whether its rows are locked on the plan above. Sorting, and a detail panel per row, come from reactable.

Usage

tbl_tree(x, theme = "light", ...)

Arguments

x

A MediaPlan, or the data frame mediaplanr::subplan_map() returns.

theme

A viz_theme() name or override list.

...

Passed to reactable::reactable(), so any of its options — defaultSorted, height, striped — reach through.

Value

A reactable htmlwidget.

See also

ec_tree(), mediaplanr::subplan_map()

Examples

topline <- mediaplanr::media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(week = as.Date("2026-07-06"), channel = c("TV", "Search"),
             planned_spend = c(100, 40)),
  grain = "channel", time = "week", name = "Q3 topline"
)
tv <- mediaplanr::media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(week = as.Date("2026-07-06"), channel = "TV",
             partner = c("NBC", "ESPN"),
             planned_spend = c(70, 50)),
  grain = c("channel", "partner"), time = "week", name = "TV detail"
)
tbl_tree(mediaplanr::attach_subplan(topline, tv))
